children: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote said on Monday that there could be a secondary listing of his oil refinery in the United States in about three to four years.
On Monday Dangote launched the initial public offering of the refinery on Nigeria's main stock exchange in Africa's largest share sale to date.
